title: Dashboard enhancements and bug fixes
body:
* **Lakehouse Real-Time warehouse support (Beta)**: AI/BI dashboards now work with Lakehouse Real-Time SQL warehouses. See [Use Lakehouse Real-Time with AI/BI dashboards](/aws/en/compute/sql-warehouse/real-time-dashboards).
* **Dashboard Insights (Beta)**: Viewers can now have Genie analyze the charts on a published dashboard page and summarize notable findings, such as trends and outliers, as insight cards. See [Dashboard Insights](/aws/en/dashboards/genie-spaces#dashboard-insights).
* **Import Power BI `.tmdl` files**: Authors can now upload Power BI `.tmdl` files to create metric views with the `/importBI` Genie Code skill. See [Import one file at a time](/aws/en/dashboards/manage/import-bi#upload-a-file).
* **Pivot table drill-down**: Viewers can now drill down through the row and column hierarchy of a pivot table one level at a time. See [Drill down in pivot tables](/aws/en/dashboards/manage/filters#pivot-drill-down).
* **Theme fonts for rich text titles**: Rich text widget titles and descriptions now inherit the dashboard theme's font styles. See [Customize colors and fonts](/aws/en/dashboards/manage/settings#custom-font).
* **Pivot table null header fix**: Pivot tables now show `NULL` values and the text `null` as separate headers instead of merging them into one.
* **Cross-dataset measure export fix**: Exported cross-dataset measures now use the measure name as the column header.
* **Decimal precision fix**: Visualizations that Genie generates now respect decimal precision.
